REQUEST FOR INFORMATION / SOURCES SOUGHT SYNOPSIS

The Department of Veterans Affairs Network Contracting Office (NCO) 19, Rocky Mountain Acquisition Center (RMAC) is issuing this source sought notice as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in providing Non-Invasive Urine Testing for Prostate Cancer. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement to support the following 
VISN 19 Facilities: 

Rocky Mountain Regional VA Medical Center (RMRVAMC), 1700 N. Wheeling St, Aurora, CO 80045 
Fort Harrison VA Medical Center (FHVAMC), 3687 Veterans Drive, Fort Harrison, MT 59636
Grand Junction VA Medical Center (GJVAMC), 2121 North Ave., Grand Junction, CO 81501
Oklahoma City VA Medical Center (OKCVAMC), 921 NE 13th St., Oklahoma City, OK 73104
Salt Lake City VA Medical Center (SLCVAMC), 500 S. Foothill Dr., Salt Lake City, UT 84148
Muskogee VA Medical Center (MVAMC), 1011 Honor Heights Drive, Muskogee, OK 74401
Ernest Childers VA Outpatient Clinic (ECVC) 8921 S Mingo Rd, Tulsa, OK 74133

The purpose of this RFI is to gather information that will assist in determining the appropriate acquisition strategy for this requirement. This notice does not constitute a solicitation and does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service.

Contractor shall provide a non-invasive urine based molecular liquid biopsy test for men such that the test provides a risk score that helps to differentiate patients with high from a low risk of aggressive prostate cancer and thus indicate the need for a prostate biopsy. The test risk score should be based on an analysis of RNA markers and should not incorporate PSA levels in its algorithm, nor require the DRE (digital rectal exam) prior to collection of the urine specimen.

The vendor shall ship test kits directly to patients with a prepaid return label to the vendor s testing facility, and, when requested by the station, provide test kits to the laboratory department for distribution to designated patients with a prepaid return label to the vendor s testing facility.

The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 621511 (Medical Laboratories).

This is a request for information and sources only, which may or may not lead to a future solicitation! This is not a solicitation. This request for capability information does not constitute a request for proposals; submission of any information in response to this market survey is purely voluntary; the government assumes no financial responsibility for any costs incurred.
